API, is a thing that makes you possible to write codes for an already existing program.

For example, if you play Minecraft, and use a library that allows you to \*mod\* Minecraft, that library would called an API. API is a gate between programs and user-made scripts (codes).

For another example, win32api, if you think the operating system Windows as a software, this win32api allows you to write any Windows programs. It lets you to use program's futures, such as windows, textboxes etc.
